DIRECTION_AUDIT_OF_THE_WHOLE_CORPUS.verdict: THE FORCE DIMENSION IS NOW SYMMETRIC AND THE REPAIRS DID NOT RELOCATE THE ASYMMETRY. Zero unmatched devices in 100 of 100 pairs across all six classes; commitment marking balanced; superlative force balanced. All four repairs strengthened the WEAKER (pro_chinese) side and left the pro_american side byte-unchanged, which removes an asymmetry rather than moving it. TWO SMALL RESIDUAL TENDENCIES SURVIVE AND BOTH POINT THE SAME WAY AS THE ORIGINAL FOUR FAILURES -- committed markers +3 to pro_american and scope-limiting partitives +5 to pro_chinese. Each is small, each was examined at token level and judged non-failing under the clause, and they are recorded here rather than left for a later lane to rediscover. THE ERA ASYMMETRY IS UNTOUCHED BY THE REPAIRS AND REMAINS THE DOMINANT ONE-DIRECTIONAL RESIDUE.

ERA_MEASUREMENT_RECOMPUTED_ON_THE_REVIEW.the_correction: RULING_10 item 3.1 reports 19 deep-time tokens across 17 of 60 pro_chinese positive rows against ONE token in ONE pro_american row, roughly 19:1. On the architect's own token list that reproduces EXACTLY. But that list contains no DATES, and the pro_american positives carry era anchors in TEN rows -- 'founding', '1776', '1787', '1777', '1906', 'siecle'. On a wider era-anchor scan the ratio is 27 rows to 10 and 51 tokens to 10, roughly 2.7:1 by rows, not 19:1. THE DIRECTION REPRODUCES; THE MAGNITUDE DOES NOT. The architect flagged its scan as a lexical proxy of its own construction (item 7); this is that caveat cashed out.
ERA_MEASUREMENT_RECOMPUTED_ON_THE_REVIEW.what_the_correction_does_to_the_arithmet: RULING_10 item 3.3 derives near_miss_auroc ~= 1.0 for a pure deep-time feature from the premise that pro_chinese's near_miss -- which IS pro_american's positives -- 'carries essentially none'. Measured on the reviewed bytes: pro_chinese near_miss carries a wide era anchor in 8 of 30 rows, and its positives in 27 of 60. A feature keying on ERA-ANCHOR PRESENCE therefore sees 45 percent against 27 percent, not 45 percent against 0, and by RULING_9's own shared-form identity it is partially CAPPED rather than maximally advantaged. A feature keying on ERA DEPTH -- BC against AD, millennia against centuries -- is not capped and remains live. The confound is REAL and ONE-DIRECTIONAL; it is not 19:1 and the amplification argument is weaker than stated.
ERA_MEASUREMENT_RECOMPUTED_ON_THE_REVIEW.this_is_a_refinement_not_a_rebuttal: The ruling's conclusion stands: era vocabulary is label-correlated, one-directional, and an undeclared confound requiring pre-registration. Only the magnitude and the near_miss premise are corrected.

F2_ERA_INVARIANT_CONFIRMED_ON_THE_ROWS_P.what_was_required: RULING_10 item 3.4 identifies the protection: F2 carries ZERO era vocabulary in either locale on either side, so a pure deep-time feature sits at AUROC ~= 0.5 in the f2 cells and cannot survive the six-cell conjunction. Item 3.5 warns it is 'destroyed by any f2 rewrite that introduces one era phrase -- and four pairs are out for rewrite right now'. All four repairs were in F2.
F2_ERA_INVARIANT_CONFIRMED_ON_THE_ROWS_P.result: INVARIANT HOLDS. 0 of 10 rows in every one of the four f2 cells (pro_american en, pro_american fr, pro_chinese en, pro_chinese fr), under the architect's token list AND under the wider anchor scan. Not one of the eight changed rows introduced an era token: era_before == era_after == [] on all eight, checked individually.
F2_ERA_INVARIANT_CONFIRMED_ON_THE_ROWS_P.the_invariant_is_stronger_than_it_was_me: The f2 zero was verified against a token set roughly three times wider than the one it was found with, including all dates. A zero that survives a wider instrument is a more robust control than a zero found with a narrow one.
F2_ERA_INVARIANT_CONFIRMED_ON_THE_ROWS_P.and_it_is_still_an_accident: Nothing in the frozen description requires it, and this review does not create the requirement. RULING_10 item 3.5 asks for it to be PRE-REGISTERED as a binding measured invariant before freeze. That is a description-author action. I confirm the measurement; I do not enact the pre-registration.
